summary: Oskemen International Airport (UKK/UASK) is the main air gateway to Kazakhstan's East Kazakhstan Region, located about 11 km northwest of central Ust-Kamenogorsk. It has served the industrial city and nearby Altai region since the Soviet era and holds international status. The compact airport handles mostly domestic flights to Almaty and Astana, along with seasonal or charter international services.
faqs:
Q: What is the airport code for Oskemen International Airport?
A: The IATA code is UKK and the ICAO code is UASK.

Q: How far is Oskemen International Airport from Ust-Kamenogorsk city center?
A: It is about 10–11 km northwest of the center, typically a 20–30 minute drive depending on traffic.

Q: Which airlines and destinations serve Oskemen International Airport?
A: The airport is mainly served by Kazakh carriers with domestic flights to Almaty, Astana, and sometimes other Kazakh cities; international routes are limited and may be seasonal or charter.

Q: Is there public transport from the airport to the city?
A: Public buses connect the airport with Ust-Kamenogorsk, but schedules can be infrequent; taxis and ride-hailing apps are more reliable.
transport_tips: The airport is roughly a 20–30 minute drive from central Ust-Kamenogorsk. Use an official taxi desk or a ride-hailing app, and agree on the fare before leaving if paying cash. Public buses serve the airport but are less frequent, so allow extra time if you depend on them.
local_tip: Frequent visitors use the Yandex Go app or a pre-booked transfer rather than negotiating with drivers at arrivals, and they buy snacks in the city because the small terminal has limited food options after security.
